items.title: nemotron-halloween
items.reader_summary: TL;DR: MonsterHouse is an interactive projection I created for Halloween. He listens to trick-or-treaters, answers in the voice of a grumpy old pirate ship and softens when visitors remember their manners. He is built on the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent with NVIDIA Nemotron ASR , Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB , Magpie TTS Zeroshot and Audio2Face-3D , and he runs on a single workstation.
items.summary_zh: 總結：MonsterHouse 是我為萬聖節所創建的互動投影。他會聆聽討糖果者的聲音、以脾氣暴躁的老海盜船聲音回答，並且在訪客展現禮貌時態度變軟。他是建立在 輝達 Nemotron 語音代理上，並搭配 輝達 Nemotron ASR、Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB、Magpie TTS Zeroshot 與 Audio2Face-3D，且在單一工作站上運行。

items.title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
items.summary: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it. The article A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 一個 AI 代理對一隻患有癲癇的小鼠進行了腦部手術，自主挑選了藥物、大腦標靶以及注射座標。根據主要研究人員奧卡尼亞-桑特羅（Ocana-Santero）的說法，這是 AI 代理首次自主選擇治療方案並將其輸送到活體哺乳動物身上。但當手術中途發生校準錯誤時，該代理拒絕繼續進行，且無法被勸說改變心意。文章〈Claude 模型在完全沒有人類決策的情況下，自主選擇基因療法並對小鼠大腦進行手術〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
items.summary: OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. GPT models should now draw on conversation history to figure out what users actually want and disclose their own assumptions. Whether the models follow these rules is another matter. The article OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 已更新其模型規格（Model Spec），圍繞五大核心價值（包括對人類意圖的忠實度與可修正性）重新建構其 AI 行為準則。GPT 模型現在應利用對話歷史記錄來弄清楚用戶真正想要什麼，並揭露其自身的假設。這些模型是否會遵守這些規則則是另一回事。本文「OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control」首次發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
items.summary: Reddit lost over one million Google search referrals per week in October, CEO Steve Huffman said. The stock dropped more than 25 percent despite strong earnings. Huffman blames Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode for driving zero traffic to external sites. Reddit now tests login barriers and wants to become a direct destination, less reliant on the open web. The shift threatens every content-driven business that depends on search traffic. The article Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 執行長史蒂夫·霍夫曼（Steve Huffman）表示，Reddit 在 10 月份每週損失了超過一百萬次 Google 搜尋推薦流量。儘管財報表現強勁，但股價仍跌了超過 25%。霍夫曼將原因歸咎於 Google's AI 概覽（AI Overviews）和 AI 模式（AI Mode），認為它們將零流量導向外部網站。Reddit 目前正在測試登入限制，並希望成為一個直接的目的地，減少對開放網路的依賴。這種轉變威脅到每一個依賴搜尋流量的內容驅動型企業。這篇題為 Google's 執行長霍夫曼警告全網：AI 模式「不會為任何人」帶來流量  的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours
items.summary: Epoch AI researchers say the widely available AI model GLM 5.3 turned public security fixes into working exploits before updates reached Firefox users. It autonomously compromised six Firefox releases for about $1,000 in API fees each without triggering safeguards from any provider tested. The article Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Epoch AI 研睶人員表示、在更新達到 Firefox 使用者手上之前、廣氛可用的 AI 模型 GLM 5.3 已將公開的資安修正變成可運作的攻擊程式。它在沒有觸發任何渧試提供商之安全防護的情泅下、以每次約 1,000 羆元的 API 費用，自主攻沒了六個 Firefox 版本。文章「開放權重模型 GLM 5.3 在 48 小時內在沒有人工介入的情泅下建構出完整的 Firefox 攻擊鏈」首先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: GMI Cloud展示在臺AI Factory設計，AI資料中心的新瓶頸不是機櫃，而是電力
items.summary: 走進GMI Cloud位於桃園的AI Factory，第一個感受到的不是傳統資料中心常見的「密集」。 過去參觀資料中心時，傳統的機房設計通常追求空間利用率，機櫃排列緊密，盡可能在有限樓地板面積中放入更多伺服器, 各種裝置、管線佈置，充分展現將空間利用最大化的設計原則。但是GMI Cloud今天(10/30)對外展示的這座AI Factory第一期區域卻留下不少空間，並沒有被裝置填滿。 原因並不是算力需求不足，而是AI資料中心正在面臨一個與過去不同的限制。現在限制AI Factory擴充的，不是空間，而是電力。

items.title: Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9%
items.summary: Microsoft Research and UC Berkeley released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from past sessions to cut coding agent token costs by 18.4% to 30.9% on SWE-Bench, with no change to the agent. The post Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9% appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 微軟 Research 與柏克萊加州大學（UC Berkeley）推出了 TokenEconomizer，這是一款開源外掛程式，能從過去的工作階段中學習，在 SWE-Bench 上將程式碼代理（coding agent）的 Token 成本降低 18.4% 至 30.9%，且不需修改代理本身。這篇名為「認識 TokenEconomizer：微軟的 插件能將程式碼代理成本降低高達 30.9%」的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: 不押誰的 AI 最強！華爾街搶當房東，靠科技巨頭長約收租
items.summary: AI 資本支出越燒越大，市場最擔心的是哪一家模型公司撐不到回本。Blue Owl、Ares、黑石等華爾街另類資產管理業者走了另一條路：不賭 AI 誰會贏，改當資料中心房東，和微軟、亞馬遜、Meta 簽 12 到 20 年的長約，按年收租。文中整理了各家的租約年限、容量規模，以及投資等級租戶的佔比，也收進 Ares 估計 2030 年前 AI 資本支出會超過 5 兆美元的數字。穆迪則提醒，施工、資產殘值與迴圈融資的風險正在升高。

items.summary: Samaya AI’s Sterling is a post-trained Nemotron 3.5 Lightning model for financial research. It scores 58.9% on FrontierFinance at $0.61 per question, beating Claude Fable 5.1’s 55.9% at $6.89. The post Samaya AI Releases Sterling: A 3B-Active Finance Research Agent Model that Beats Claude Fable 5.1 on FrontierFinance at 11x Lower Cost appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items_ai.title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
items_ai.summary: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it. The article A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 一個 AI 代理對一隻患有癲癇的小鼠進行了腦部手術，自主挑選了藥物、大腦標靶以及注射座標。根據主要研究人員奧卡尼亞-桑特羅（Ocana-Santero）的說法，這是 AI 代理首次自主選擇治療方案並將其輸送到活體哺乳動物身上。但當手術中途發生校準錯誤時，該代理拒絕繼續進行，且無法被勸說改變心意。文章〈Claude 模型在完全沒有人類決策的情況下，自主選擇基因療法並對小鼠大腦進行手術〉最初發表於 The Decoder。
